title: [WIP] Optimize bulk operation method for better performance
body:
## ObjectStack Spec: Bulk Operations & Realtime Subscription Support

### Summary
Enhance ObjectStack protocol specification to support:
1. **Batch Operations Optimization** - Complete bulk operation definitions for efficient data processing
2. **Real-time Subscription Support** - WebSocket/SSE based real-time data synchronization

### Implementation Plan

#### Phase 1: Analysis & Documentation
- [x] Explore existing codebase structure
- [x] Review current driver interface (`driver.zod.ts`)
- [x] Review current API contracts (`contract.zod.ts`)
- [x] Review existing realtime protocols (`realtime.zod.ts`, `websocket.zod.ts`)
- [x] Review client implementation (`client/src/index.ts`)
- [ ] Document current state and gaps

#### Phase 2: Driver Capabilities Enhancement
- [ ] Add `bulkOperations` capability flag to `DriverCapabilitiesSchema`
- [ ] Add `realtime` capability flag to `DriverCapabilitiesSchema`
- [ ] Update driver interface documentation for bulk methods
- [ ] Add tests for new capability flags

#### Phase 3: API Contract Updates
- [ ] Review and enhance bulk operation API contracts
- [ ] Ensure consistency between driver interface and API contracts
- [ ] Add realtime subscription contracts if missing
- [ ] Update contract tests

#### Phase 4: Client Protocol Enhancement  
- [ ] Verify client bulk methods match driver spec
- [ ] Add realtime client interface definitions
- [ ] Document client usage patterns
- [ ] Add TypeScript examples

#### Phase 5: Testing & Validation
- [ ] Run existing test suite
- [ ] Add/update tests for bulk operations
- [ ] Add/update tests for realtime subscriptions
- [ ] Validate all schemas compile correctly
- [ ] Review for security vulnerabilities

#### Phase 6: Final Review
- [ ] Code review
- [ ] Security scan with CodeQL
- [ ] Documentation completeness check
- [ ] Final validation

<!-- START COPILOT ORIGINAL PROMPT -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> B. 批量操作优化
> 
> 现状: bulk() 方法逐个处理记录
> 问题:
> 
> ❌ N+1 查询问题（update 操作）
> ❌ 无事务支持
> ❌ 错误处理不友好
> 优化方案:
> 
> // 利用 ObjectStack Client 的批量 API
> async bulk(resource: string, operation: 'create' | 'update' | 'delete', data: Partial<T>[]) {
>   await this.connect();
>   
>   try {
>     switch (operation) {
>       case 'create':
>         return await this.client.data.createMany(resource, data);
>       case 'update':
>         // 使用批量更新而非逐个更新
>         return await this.client.data.updateMany(resource, data);
>       case 'delete':
>         const ids = data.map(item => (item as any).id);
>         await this.client.data.deleteMany(resource, ids);
>         return [];
>     }
>   } catch (error) {
>     // 添加部分成功处理
>     throw new BulkOperationError(error, operation, data);
>   }
> }
> 需要 @objectstack/client 支持:
> 
> ✅ createMany() - 已存在
> ✅ deleteMany() - 已存在
> ❌ updateMany() - 需要新增 或提供批量 patch API
> C. 实时订阅支持
> 
> 现状: 仅支持轮询刷新
> 需求: WebSocket/SSE 实时数据更新
> 
> 架构设计:
> 
> // packages/data-objectstack/src/RealtimeAdapter.ts
> export class RealtimeObjectStackAdapter extends ObjectStackAdapter {
>   private subscriptions = new Map<string, Subscription>();
>   
>   // 订阅资源变更
>   subscribe(resource: string, params?: QueryParams, callback: (data: any) => void) {
>     const ws = this.client.realtime.subscribe(resource, params);
>     ws.on('change', callback);
>     this.subscriptions.set(`${resource}:${JSON.stringify(params)}`, ws);
>     return () => ws.close();
>   }
>   
>   // 取消所有订阅
>   unsubscribeAll() {
>     this.subscriptions.forEach(sub => sub.close());
>     this.subscriptions.clear();
>   }
> }
> 需要 @objectstack/client 支持:
> 
> 新增 client.realtime API
> WebSocket 连接管理
> 事件类型: 'create' | 'update' | 'delete'
> 订阅过滤器支持


</details>
